import os
import requests
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

app = FastAPI()

@app.middleware("http")
async def logstream_telemetry_tracker(request: Request, call_next):
    start_time = time.time()
    response = await call_next(request)
    process_time = int((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)
    
    payload = {
        "apiKey": os.getenv("LOGSTREAM_API_KEY"),
        "message": f"FastAPI Core Route Processed {request.method} -> Duration {process_time}ms",
        "level": "INFO",
        "url": str(request.url),
        "os": "Asynchronous ASGI Framework Container"
    }
    
    requests.post(os.getenv("LOGSTREAM_INGEST_URL"), json=payload, timeout=1.5)
    return response

<?php
function dispatchLogStreamTelemetry($message, $level = 'INFO', $contextUrl = '/') {
    $payload = [
        'apiKey' => getenv('LOGSTREAM_API_KEY'),
        'message' => $message,
        'level' => $level,
        'url' => $contextUrl,
        'os' => 'PHP FPM Application Server'
    ];

    $ch = curl_init(getenv('LOGSTREAM_INGEST_URL'));
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json.dumps($payload));
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, ['Content-Type: application/json']);
    curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 2);
    
    curl_exec($ch);
    curl_close($ch);
}
